messages:
irene: noticed weird keystore activity during onprem stress run, pasting snippet.
irene: log: `2026-03-20T22:14:02Z keystore.call user=svc-infer-agg action=decrypt key=prv-01 src=10.2.14.9 status=OK` then immediately `... action=rotate key=prv-01 status=200 src=10.2.14.9` with burst of admin calls.
alice: which env/cluster?
irene: private-vpc-east-2 / onprem-edge-3. Load harness not tied to that ip.
dan: can we map svc-infer-agg to a node identity in RBAC logs? token reuse is a possibility.
frank: need full proxy headers (x-actor, x-tenant, x-auth-method).
irene: headers: `x-actor: svc-infer-agg@redwood.local`, `x-auth-method: mTLS`, `cert-subject: CN=svc-infer-agg,O=prod`.
carla: mTLS + matching CN usually strong. Could be host compromised or private key leaked. Any recent rotations?
irene: cert issued 2026-03-10, not due. No alerts before.
devsec-bot: created SEC-2026-1034. Triage checklist linked.
alice: triage checklist: (1) confirm keystore accepted src outside expected subnet, (2) collect process list + identity from 10.2.14.9, (3) pull audit logs for grant/rotate events.
dan: pulling conntrack and netpol logs. Reminder: netpol allows controlplane -> keystore on 8443; local compromise can still hit the socket. Check iptables/conntrack at window.
frank: `kubectl logs -n keystore keystore-proxy-0 --since=15m` shows repeated decrypt+rotate. Saw `X-Forwarded-For: 10.2.14.9,127.0.0.1`. Proxy chain present.
carla: could be a jump host lateral. Jumpbox audit?
irene: jumpbox shows infra@redwood session active then, infra team denies action.
alice: hypothesis list: stolen service cert, compromised host with key, or automation replay bug. Need artifacts.
dan: action items:
- A1: quarantine 10.2.14.9 (carla)
- A2: snapshot host, collect ps/ss/proc (frank)
- A3: export keystore audit + request bodies (alice)
- A4: rotate & revoke svc-infer-agg cert/key (irene)
- A5: add scenario to runbook & tests (dan)

carla: applying deny-all netpol + egress proxy rule to isolate 10.2.14.9 now.
frank: snapshot done, collecting `ss -tunap`, `ps aux`, `/var/log/syslog`, uploading to SEC-2026-1034. Found process `./influx-agent` launched at 22:12, not in baseline.
alice: keystore audit export: 3 rotation calls in 40s, all 200. Bodies show `rotation_reason: automated`, `initiated_by: svc-infer-agg`. Correlation ids differ (different X-Request-Id).
irene: checking cert usage on host: `openssl x509 -in /etc/ssl/svc-infer-agg.pem -noout -text` CN ok, need private key usage evidence.
devsec-bot: reminder: follow least-privilege escalation checklist before key ops.
carla: propose temporary quick RBAC gate: deny `keystore.rotate` from service accounts not in `controlplane-sa` for 10m.
dan: implementing RBAC quickfix audit rule: deny rotate if requester namespace != controlplane for 10m then revert to audit-only.
frank: pcap shows outbound TLS to 54.23.12.9:443 around same time; not in allowlist. Pulling file exfil indicators.
alice: 54.23.12.9 flagged as unknown vendor IP, adding to IOCs.
irene: performed cert/key rotation for svc-infer-agg, added old key to CRL and KMS revocation list. Need verification across consumers.
dan: post-rotation validation: confirm failed auths using old cert in keystore-proxy logs, run infra smoke tests, and ensure dependent jobs reauthenticate.
carla: drafting runbook PR `docs/runbooks/onprem-keystore-lateral.md` with quarantine snippets, netpol commands, and triage checklist.
frank: requesting telemetry to add a regression that simulates repeated rotate calls from off-subnet sources and asserts pager.
alice: add postmortem checklist item: verify conntrack/iptables staleness as possible root cause allowing session reuse.
irene: summarizing timeline and attaching artifacts to SEC-2026-1034.
carla: scheduling tabletop for keystore compromise scenario next week. :calendar:
devsec-bot: SEC-2026-1034 status -> Contained. Next steps assigned.
irene: thanks — if anyone finds more indicators, drop them into SEC-2026-1034.
